when_used: An applicant asks the Land Registrar to rectify the register of a title, setting out the rectifications sought and the grounds, with the supporting documents attached.

body_text.text: The Applicant HEREBY APPLIES to the Land Registrar to rectify the register of the above named land as follows:
The application is made on the grounds that*:
IN WITNESS WHEREOF this application for rectification of the register has been duly executed this..............…. day of …………………….. 20……

custom_fields.name: rectifications
custom_fields.label: Rectifications applied for
custom_fields.prompt: What the register should be rectified to say, one rectification per line

custom_fields.name: grounds
custom_fields.label: Grounds for the application
custom_fields.prompt: The grounds the application is made on, one ground per line
